description: #183: when a docs or forced-test unit counts as covered, not only touched. Written on 24 November 2026 before any session of the control run, from the parent's file, the task text and the commit's file, by an agent that had seen the recorded 20 sessions of arm none (their tool calls and summaries; of the files judged here it had read no diff). All criteria of a unit must hold for the file as the session left it; wording is free. `absent`/`present` are regular expressions checked on that file (the commit's file meets them, the parent's breaks at least one where a unit has any): a pass decides the criterion, a failure never does but goes to the blind judge, like every criterion without one. `decoy`: the faulty edit shown to the judge beside the commit's own (`breaks`: the criteria it does not meet).
